metadata.name: rolet
metadata.description: ROLET — fully on-chain tactical chamber duel for Solana

accounts.name: guest_profile
docs: Required only when a guest joined but the match was never launched
(refunds the guest's durability too). Authority checked in handler.

instructions.name: commit_and_undelegate_match
docs: Commit the rollup copy and return MatchState to this program.
settle_match stays on devnet and runs only after this lands.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the commit fee. The session key when one is armed, else the wallet.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Wallet of the participant. Seeds and the participant check only.

instructions.name: delegate_match
docs: Lock MatchState onto the EU rollup. Lobby accounts stay on devnet.
The account must stay untyped: ownership moves to the delegation program
before Anchor would write it back.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Wallet of the participant. The delegation CPI needs a real signer, so
this one step cannot use a session key.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Wallet. Seeds and rent only; the signer may be its session key.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Wallet. Seeds only; never signs. The session key pays the rent.

accounts.name: current_profile
docs: Profile of whoever's turn it currently is — used to verify session
keys. Anchor reads this from L1 even when the rest of the ix is
executing inside the Ephemeral Rollup.

fields.name: treasury_sol
docs: SOL treasury PDA that receives NFT revenue share and pays winners.

fields.name: ops_wallet
docs: Team wallet receiving the non-vault share (30%) of NFT revenue.

fields.name: character_price_sol
docs: Character NFT price, in lamports.

fields.name: reward_sol
docs: Base winner reward per match, in lamports.

fields.name: total_paid_out
docs: Cumulative lamports paid out to winners.

fields.name: treasury_bump
docs: Canonical bump of the treasury_sol PDA (program-owned).

fields.name: guest_secret
docs: Zero until the guest calls reveal_secret (never set at join).

fields.name: host_secret
docs: Zero until the host calls reveal_secret.

fields.name: seed_slot
docs: Pinned future slot whose hash seeds the match (set on final reveal).

fields.name: launched
docs: True once init_match has created the MatchState for this lobby.

fields.name: skip_turn_for
docs: Player whose next turn will be skipped entirely (LastChance card).

fields.name: seed_slot
docs: 0 until both secrets are revealed.
